name: Isabel
testimonial:
Teacher Suegne is genuinely one of the best tutors I have ever had. She doesn’t just explain the work and move on. She takes the time to make sure you understand every single step. She gives you different methods and ways of understanding the work, and she is always patient, calm and kind.

She made me understand Physics when other people couldn’t, and that is something I will always appreciate about her. She genuinely cares about her students and always goes the extra mile to help them succeed.

Anyone would be lucky to have her as their tutor ❤️
